review:
Hacksaw's RotoGrid: every RotoGrid symbol turns the whole grid a quarter turn clockwise – up to three times a spin – which can create brand-new wins.

After each turn, wilds on the same reel connect and fill everything between them, so repeated rotations can spread wilds all over. Might of Hercules can also strike once the grid settles, turning every copy of a random low symbol wild. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game. Great if you like weird grids.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
